two-handed.description: Two-handed weapons, crossbows, longbows, heavy armor

one-handed-light.description: One-handed light weapons, hand crossbow, shield, light armor

upgradeKit.description: Cost = one-handed tier price at target level / 3. Roll 1d20 + smith tools proficiency >= 5 + item current level to succeed. Multi-level upgrades require succeeding on each level. Consumed on use.

blacksmithUpgrade.description: Cost = (next level price - current level price) + 5% of next level price. Requires blacksmith competence level. Does not replenish durability.
